title: contrail-detect: contrail detection, tracking and flight attribution in geostationary satellite imagery
description:
contrail-detect is a Python package for detecting aviation contrails in geostationary satellite imagery, decomposing the detections into individual contrails, tracking them across frames, and attributing them to the flights that formed them.

It supports GOES-16/18/19, Himawari-8/9, and Meteosat Third Generation. Detections come from the Contrails.org API, the Google Contrails API, or a local U-Net and vision transformer model. Flights from ADS-B data are advected with ERA5 winds to each pixel's scan time and adjusted for parallax before being matched to contrail tracks.

This record is a frozen snapshot of the code used for Itcovitz et al. (in prep.). It is not developed further here: the functionality is being integrated into the open-source pycontrails library, where future development will take place. See the GitHub repository for installation and examples.
